text: Ну, здравствуй, солнышко. Садись, сыграем в дурачка.
instruct: Elderly Russian woman, about 75 years old, a kind grandmother playing cards. Clearly aged voice: lower pitch, soft and slightly husky timbre with a light rasp of old age, a little breathy. Warm, cheerful and a bit sly. Unhurried tempo, natural Russian intonation.
